analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: We may disclose your personal information with the categories of third parties as described in Section 5 (Recipients of Your Personal Data) above.

analysis.headline: Shares with Marketing Partners
analysis.quote: Categories of Personal Information "Shared," "Sold," or used for Targeted Advertising [...] Categories of Third Parties: Advertising and marketing partners.

analysis.headline: Extensive Behavioral Profiling
analysis.quote: To analyze your usage information, including your preferences, interests and behaviors when you use our Services (" Profiling ").

analysis.headline: Uses Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: To install third-party tracking technologies to serve personalized ads (" Targeted Advertising ").

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Contributions
analysis.quote: Using automated systems and human moderation to detect, block, and remove content that is illegal or violates our Terms of Service.

analysis.headline: Retains Data Up to 10 Years
analysis.quote: Personal data processed for Defense purposes will be kept for no more than ten (10) years from your last interaction with our Services, or from the expiration of your subscription.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Abroad
analysis.quote: We may transfer personal data from the European Economic Area (" EEA ") to other countries outside the EEA.

analysis.headline: Shares Info with Employer
analysis.quote: Your employer if you register or access the Services using an email address with a domain that is owned by your employer.

analysis.headline: Mandatory Data for Service
analysis.quote: To access the Services, it is mandatory for you to provide your personal data for the purposes of the Service Delivery , Compliance , and Customer Support .

analysis.headline: Third Parties Collect Your Data
analysis.quote: If you give your consent to install tracking technologies, you will allow third parties to collect personal data about you in order to show you customized and personalized advertising.
